name: boiler-snake
description: Boiler Snake: XP + leveling + roles with per-guild settings.
//: test:coverage = Node's built-in runner coverage (no deps) over src/ for BOTH suites in one run; include/exclude keep src/ only in the report. Threshold flags check OVERALL totals (node exits 1 when unmet). Gate raised 2026-10-11 (audit issue #203) from the stale 77/67/77 to 88/76/87: actuals re-measured on main the same day (all files: lines 89.48%, branches 77.47%, funcs 88.54%), so every gate keeps >1pt margin; CI enforces it on the Node 22.x leg of .github/workflows/test.yml (V8 versions can shift totals a little — if that leg goes red on totals, re-measure on CI's Node and re-baseline per house style, actuals-minus-3 rounded down, not to mask a regression). Team targets are critical-paths 100% / high 90%+ (standards) — raise thresholds as coverage improves; never lower the gate to accommodate a regression.
